description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget 'DashboardScreen' along with some nested widgets and a custom painter for visualizing expense data as a pie chart and bar chart. It is part of a personal expense tracker app and renders various UI components to display spending summaries by category.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays expense data breakdowns in pie and bar chart formats, using data from application state.

classes.name: _PiePainter
classes.description: A custom painter that draws a pie chart representing expense category proportions.

classes.name: _BarChart
classes.description: A widget that renders a bar chart visualization of expense data per category.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for 'DashboardScreen' that constructs the UI including pie and bar charts.

methods.name: _PiePainter.paint
methods.description: Custom painting logic for drawing pie chart segments based on expense data.

methods.name: _PiePainter.shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines whether the pie painter requires repainting; always returns true for simplicity.

methods.name: _colorFallback
methods.description: Provides a default color for a given expense category if no specific color is assigned.

methods.name: _BarChart.build
methods.description: Constructs the bar chart layout, scaling bar heights according to expense data.
